definition: This dimension controls how actions are executed concurrently among players and enemies during combat turns, allowing for strategic interactions and potential for varying outcomes based on simultaneous execution. Variations can include fully simultaneous actions where all participants act at once, or partially simultaneous where some actions are resolved sequentially after others.
exclusion_criteria: Real-time action execution without turn-based structure
inclusion_criteria: All players and enemies act at the same time
Actions may impact each other in real-time during the turn
title: Simultaneous Actions in Turn-Based Combat
